correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Heydari 2005 W^3 Eq.(23) as the three families of 2x2 minors with a spectator index fixed. For |Phi+>_12 tensor |0>_3 the sum of squared minors is exactly 1/4; for the state after H on spectator it is exactly 1/8. Independently computed these from coefficient tensors with exact rational/symbolic arithmetic. Multiplying H by i gives determinant(iH)=1, a local SU(2) operation, and changes the state only by global phase. Therefore C_after/C_before=1/sqrt(2) for every positive normalizer N. A genuine LOCC monotone must be invariant under invertible deterministic local unitaries (apply U and U^{-1}), so the 2005 claimed monotonicity fails as stated. The example is biseparable, specifically admitted in source scope, and does not address a later revised functional.
